description: This file defines a data transfer object (DTO) class LicenseSearchFilterParams used for filtering license search results in the OrangeHRM system. It extends base filter parameters and specifies allowed sorting fields.

classes.name: LicenseSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A DTO class for license search filter parameters, allowing sorting by license name.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the filter parameters with a default sort field 'l.name'.
